## Ctx.sessionGet() method

Retrieves session data for the current user.

**Signature:**

```typescript
sessionGet(): Promise<ITCacheRpc | null>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[ITCacheRpc](./gramstax.itcacherpc.md) \| null&gt;

The session data, or null if not found or on error.

## Remarks

Fetches the session from external cache and updates the local session property.

## Example


```typescript
async textFree() {
  const session = await this.sessionGet()
  if (session?.params?.step === "awaiting_name") {
    // Handle name input
  }
}
```
